fusions.name: Biting Through
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 18 damage, consuming every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage per affliction, leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed Denticles
fusions.desc: Sheds 3 of your armoured scales at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rasping Hide
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn to the Wound
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5%.
